decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the 2.8–4.6V battery input and the battery-to-AXP2101 power path.
The supported battery input range and connection to AXP2101 do not change the existing overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The battery voltage range and AXP2101 destination do not alter the requirement to monitor battery temperature through the J_BAT NTC connection.
The battery-interface change does not alter boost enable control, and the separate 5V mapping in the same source is already represented by a complete candidate MODIFY.
Connecting the battery to AXP2101 does not change the main-board 3.3V OR-ing behavior, whose same-message power-source mapping is already recorded.
The battery-interface values do not change standalone USB power behavior, and the source's separate LDO mapping is already captured by a same-message MODIFY.
Battery voltage and connection destination do not change the independently stated SK6812 supply-voltage and GPIO3 switching requirements.
The battery-interface change has no effect on the power-board USB-C connector type, data-line support, or sourceability constraints.
The source does not change the charge-status indicator, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The electrical battery range and AXP2101 destination do not alter the existing board dimensions, mounting, orientation, or connector-placement constraints.
The battery-interface change does not affect the required eight-layer power-board stack.
The battery voltage range and AXP2101 connection do not change the independent TVS-based ESD-protection requirement.
